events.note:
Despite C1332 indicating that the marriage record exists in the 1910 book under act #27, the only available source from AGAD (Gmina: Rożyszcze. Diecezja: wołyńska. Księga metrykalna ślubów., 1/439/0/-/302) does not contain this record. Therefore, C1332 references the index of marriages which only provides basic information.

C1708 provides the full date of marriage as 1940-02-02.
